name: eCircuitMania
description: Sends rounds and optionally finishes to eCircuitMania while a match is being recorded.
author: TMControlPanel
helpText:
This plugin sends round results, and finishes if enabled, to eCircuitMania.
Commands:
/ecm - Opens the eCircuitMania window

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Your eCircuitMania match ID and auth token, separated by an underscore.

sendFinishes.title: Send player finishes
sendFinishes.description: Also send every finish during a round. Round results are always sent while recording.
